title: Identify schools in Los Angeles County that are directly funded charter sch
question: Identify schools in Los Angeles County that are directly funded charter schools with a K–12 free meal eligibility rate below 18%, and whose difference between K–12 enrollment and Ages 5–17 enrollment exceeds the average enrollment difference across all directly funded charter schools in Los Angeles County. Return the school name, city, phone number, and this enrollment difference.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    s."XCL_058" AS phone_number,
    (f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") AS enrollment_difference
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s."XCL_065" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."XCL_063" = 1
  AND (f."XCL_020" * 100.0 / f."XCL_019") < 18
  AND (f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."XCL_019" - f2."XCL_024")
      FROM frpm AS f2
      INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2."XCL_001" = s2."XCL_041"
      WHERE s2."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
        AND s2."XCL_065" = 'Directly funded'
        AND s2."XCL_063" = 1
  )
